diagnosis: The endpoint queries live matchmaking state and game board positions directly from a Redis hash key using matchSessionId. It does not check whether req.user.gamerTag is one of the matched players or registered spectators. Any authenticated player can inspect active match boards of ongoing competitive games.
exploit_request:
GET /api/game/match/match_championship_99014/state HTTP/1.1
Host: play.esportsarena.com
Authorization: Bearer <gamer_token>
